summary: The WelcomeStaffAdmin class provides UI components and logic for the staff admin welcome page, including last login details and site/discipline filtering for employment applications. It includes dropdowns for filtering applications, validators for date inputs, and mechanisms to refresh data.
purpose: To present a welcome page to staff admin users, with information about their last login and options to filter and view employment applications.

workflows.name: View Employment Applications
steps: Select site and discipline from dropdowns.
Validate start and end date inputs.
Filter applications based on provided criteria.

validations: Validate date format for start and end dates.
Ensure start date is not after end date.
conditions: Show withdrawn applications based on checkbox selection.
system_behavior: Register and set up necessary JavaScript scripts.
Initialize dropdowns with site and discipline data.
